annotations.title: Put a dismissed match (or a ruled-out company) back

description: Put a dismissed match (or a ruled-out company) back. Send the key from list_dismissed, or the job id or title and company; with whole_company, or a company alone, the company comes back too. Only on the person's word. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.

company.description: Company name. Alone, it puts the whole company back.

job_id.description: A job id instead of the key.

title.description: Job title, with company, instead of the key.

whole_company.description: Also put back the whole company.

name: restore_match
